LanguageData.XPC_L3_QuickProfilesTip: Browse saved profiles. The menu contains profile choices only; selection opens a verified review window. Applying a selected profile requires a separate explicit confirmation; opening this menu never applies settings.
LanguageData.XPC_L3_ManageProfilesTip: Open Profile Manager to save, inspect, rename, update, delete and restore profiles. Browsing does not change current XP settings; applying requires separate confirmation.
LanguageData.XPC_L3_ResetDefaultsTip: Reset all XP Customizer settings, including ON/OFF switches and curve modes, to this mod's installation defaults. Existing profiles are preserved. Missing bundled profiles (Long x3 / Very Long x6) are recreated on confirmed Reset.
LanguageData.XPC_L3_ReserveDesc: Controls how much XP can be stored at level 20 before skill decay can push the skill back toward level 19.
